codex.usless_mobs.line8: §7Before the wind had a name, before the stone
codex.usless_mobs.line9: §7could keep secrets, there were those who
codex.usless_mobs.line11: §7They pulled it. They wove. They sang.
codex.usless_mobs.line12: §8§oWe do not remember what they sang.
codex.usless_mobs.line15: §7Every leap across the void leaves a §cscratch§7.
codex.usless_mobs.line21: §7The small things of the void are easy hosts.
codex.usless_mobs.line27: §7Kill what is not a mite, and a §cfragment§7 falls.
codex.usless_mobs.line28: §7Eight fragments. Bound in a ring. They become §cone§7.
codex.usless_mobs.line29: §7The one wants to be a blade.
codex.usless_mobs.line30: §7Feed it the metal that does not burn.
codex.usless_mobs.line31: §7Feed it the last breath of the §ccrowned thing§7.
codex.usless_mobs.line32: §7Add wood. It needs to be held.
codex.usless_mobs.line35: §7Watch your own heart while you hold it.
codex.usless_mobs.line41: §7Each cut leaves a mark on you. Ten marks may burn.
codex.usless_mobs.line42: §7Stillness lets them fade. Motion keeps them lit.
codex.usless_mobs.line46: §7The void counts. It does not forget.
codex.usless_mobs.line48: §8  · §6at two hundred fifty - it speaks louder.
codex.usless_mobs.line53: §7When enemies circle close, twist the blade.
codex.usless_mobs.line54: §7When the field is empty, push it forward instead.
codex.usless_mobs.line58: §7Other paths exist. Old libraries hold echoes.
codex.usless_mobs.line60: §8§o— and the crowned thing is not the last king. —
codex.usless_mobs.line63: §7Should the blade already lie in another's hand,
codex.usless_mobs.line64: §7do not press the void with empty wanting.
codex.usless_mobs.line68: §8  · §4§lFour times — and you are no longer.
codex.usless_mobs.line69: §8§oThe void counts in fours. It always has.
codex.usless_mobs.line72: §7Slime is not weak. It is memory that learned to bounce.
codex.usless_mobs.line73: §7Blue carries motion. Gold carries mercy and command.
codex.usless_mobs.line74: §7Together they make the light side: crown, reactor, guard.
codex.usless_mobs.line75: §8§oThe King is not evil. He is a trial with a crown.
codex.usless_mobs.line79: §7The void touched slime first in the End.
codex.usless_mobs.line81: §7Ender Slimes carry the dark between jumps.
codex.usless_mobs.line82: §7Set a Dark Crystal into one, and the light answers.
codex.usless_mobs.line92: §7Bind it with Void Slime and eyes that saw the End.
codex.usless_mobs.line93: §7The Void Summoner opens a wound, not a portal.
codex.usless_mobs.line98: §7Silverfish were the first ears of stone.
codex.usless_mobs.line100: §7Where infested stone whispers, a shard waits.
codex.usless_mobs.line101: §7Nine shards bind into the crystal of the deep.
codex.usless_mobs.line102: §8§oDo not only seek monsters. Seek silence.
codex.usless_mobs.line104: §7The leggings carry the swarm's crawling memory.
codex.usless_mobs.line108: §7Not every light is slime. Some lights root.
codex.usless_mobs.line109: §7Animals carry Nature Crystal like dew in fur.
codex.usless_mobs.line111: §7On moss and rooted dirt, the Warden answers.
codex.usless_mobs.line112: §8§oIt is not a king. It is a boundary.
codex.usless_mobs.line113: §7Its core feeds armor, necklace, and crown.
codex.usless_mobs.line114: §7Who creates life must also defend it.
codex.usless_mobs.line119: §7A Helping Amethyst carries light and trust.
codex.usless_mobs.line120: §7Give it freely, and a Helping Soul remains.
codex.usless_mobs.line121: §7It wakes the Celestial Crystal not with force,
codex.usless_mobs.line123: §8§oThe bright path does not command. It asks.
codex.usless_mobs.line128: §7The Void Crystal does not sleep. It counts.
codex.usless_mobs.line129: §7Blood offerings wake it, but do not own it.
codex.usless_mobs.line130: §7Twenty-five cries make it open its eye.
codex.usless_mobs.line131: §7Then crystal becomes core, and core becomes scythe.
codex.usless_mobs.line132: §8§oThe Voidbound blade is still the same blade.
codex.usless_mobs.line138: §7Dark is not evil. Bright is not safe.
codex.usless_mobs.line139: §7Life is not gentle. It grows through bone.
codex.usless_mobs.line140: §7Three paths argue until one brow carries them.
codex.usless_mobs.line141: §7Void, Celestial, and Living are set within.
codex.usless_mobs.line142: §8§oThen the crown is no longer a reward.
codex.usless_mobs.line148: §7When the Balanced Crown is born, three altars answer.
codex.usless_mobs.line149: §5Void§7 gives hunger, shadow, silence, and projectile-devouring dark.
codex.usless_mobs.line150: §bCelestial§7 gives speed, shine, mercy, and radiant protection.
codex.usless_mobs.line151: §2Living§7 gives roots, breath, cleansing, and second hearts.
codex.usless_mobs.line152: §7Choose one altar. The other two fall quiet.
codex.usless_mobs.line154: §7After allegiance, even old bosses remember your name.

lore.usless_mobs.three_paths.page1:
§8From a broken tablet:

§0Three paths slept beneath the same earth. The bright path bounced, healed, and clung to all that wanted to live. The dark path cut, counted, and never forgot. The third path grew quietly between bone and moss.
lore.usless_mobs.three_paths.page2: §0Who carries one path becomes strong. Who binds two becomes dangerous. Who sets all three into a crown is no longer rewarded. They are judged.
lore.usless_mobs.bright_slime.page1:
§8A court alchemist's margin note:

§0Blue Slime is motion. Golden Slime is mercy. Void Slime is the place where light stops being safe. The King was never only a monster; he was the first trial.
lore.usless_mobs.bright_slime.page2: §0The crown was meant to protect, not replace the wearer. So it pulses instead of burning forever. Whoever wears it should still have to leap, fall, rise, and fight.
lore.usless_mobs.celestial_slime.page1:
§8From an End ship log:

§0In the End we saw slime that did not break. It bent around the void like water around stone. We called it Celestial because we feared naming it truly.
lore.usless_mobs.celestial_slime.page2: §0An Allay sang near it. The crystal answered not command, but help. Perhaps that is the difference between light and rule.
lore.usless_mobs.corrupted_deep.page1:
§8Carved into stone:

§0Silverfish were messengers of the deep. Then came the shard. Since then they hide not from fear, but from patience.
lore.usless_mobs.corrupted_deep.page2: §0The seeker should not dig forever. The Resonator hears the tiny teeth behind stone. The bait calls them. The shard falls rarely because power should not grow from comfort.
lore.usless_mobs.living_roots.page1:
§8From a moss-wet prayer book:

§0Nature Crystal is not found in ore veins. It rests in breath, fur, frost, and tissue. Life gives it up only when the world sees you are strong enough to protect it.
lore.usless_mobs.living_roots.page2: §0The Living Core does not belong to the hunter. It belongs to the boundary between growth and hunger. When the crystal awakens, Strays come, because frost hates new life.
lore.usless_mobs.void_reaper.page1:
§8From a black page:

§0The Reaper is not a door. It is what hunts through a door when one stares too long. Its crystal is cold until blood reminds it of time.
lore.usless_mobs.void_reaper.page2: §0Twenty-five offerings wake the Void Crystal. Yet the scythe remains the same scythe. One blade may have only one story, or the void writes the ending.
lore.usless_mobs.true_crown.page1:
§8Last readable line of a crown:

§0Do not set dark against bright. Do not set life against death. Set them together and they will argue until three altars wake.
lore.usless_mobs.true_crown.page2: §0The Balanced Crown is not the end. It is the question. Void, Celestial, and Living wait for the answer.

lore.usless_mobs.tome.intro:
§8Chronicle of All Paths§0

Collected from broken tablets, drowned logbooks and the margins of the Codex. Everything the three paths left behind - bound in one book.
lore.usless_mobs.tome.codex_header:
§8The Codex chapter:§0

What follows is the Codex, copied line by line. The bright path of the slimes and the dark path of the Reaper, as the first hand wrote it.
lore.usless_mobs.king_slime.page1:
§8Slime-court chronicle:

§0Before the paths had names, the slimes had a king. He drank the night sky and wore a crown not made for him. Whoever holds the crown commands the gel - but the gel remembers its king.
lore.usless_mobs.king_slime.page2: §0When the King Slime falls, his crown does not break. It waits. A trophy on a pedestal, a whisper under glass: every kingdom is only borrowed.
lore.usless_mobs.ender_schleim.page1:
§8Found beside a broken portal frame:

§0Some slime fell through the End and came back wrong. It carries little doors in its body. Do not trust a puddle that blinks.
lore.usless_mobs.ocean_court.page1:
§8Waterlogged ship journal:

§0The reef keeps its own court. Drowned wear coral like armor and pull swimmers down with the current. An octopus with eight patient arms guards the gate.
lore.usless_mobs.ocean_court.page2: §0Above them all: the Witch of Life. She does not drown you. She lets the sea decide, and sends root spirits when it hesitates. Bring light, bring speed, and do not fight her in deep water.
lore.usless_mobs.living_wild.page1:
§8Notes of a frozen ranger:

§0The living path has wardens. A stray crowned in ice that never misses twice. A cave spider that walks inside its own web. A husk with roots where its heart should be.
lore.usless_mobs.living_wild.page2: §0Bats with moss-green bellies carry seeds through the dark. And deep in the grove the Living Warden sleeps - bark for skin, lichen for eyes. Wake it only if your armor grew, not was forged.
lore.usless_mobs.allegiance.page1:
§8Altar inscription, thrice repeated:

§0Void takes. Celestial gives. Living keeps. Three altars, one choice, no way back. The Balanced Crown asks the question - the altars are the answer.
